tagline: 理光便携相机，1992 年发布
description: 理光于1992年推出的便携相机。配备Dual focal length, 35mm f/4.5 (3 elements, 3 groups) & 55mm f/7.2 (5 elements, 5 groups)。快门速度Programmed, 1/3 - 1/350 sec.。感光度ISO 50 - 1600 (DX-code system)。Single-point active autofocus system, 5 focusing steps。

specs.镜头: Dual focal length, 35mm f/4.5 (3 elements, 3 groups) & 55mm f/7.2 (5 elements, 5 groups)
specs.对焦: Single-point active autofocus system, 5 focusing steps
specs.英文简介: The Myport Dual mini is a bi-focal autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in June 1992.
